description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'TestConstants' containing static constants, methods, and nested classes used for testing the Eclipse Ditto connectivity and messaging components. It includes mock server setup, sample data, configuration objects, and helper methods for creating connections, actors, messages, and other test artifacts to facilitate unit and integration testing of the system.

classes.name: TestConstants
classes.description: A final utility class housing test constants, mock server methods, configuration setups, and helper functions for testing the Ditto connectivity messaging system.
